<!-- roadmap-reconciliation-2026-09-26 -->
## Current scope — September 26, 2026

[Current roadmap](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/roadmap-2026-09-26.md) · [Official versions/conflicts](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/evidence/2026-09-26-issue4/competition-contract.md). This amendment supersedes conflicting qualification assumptions in the older sections below; existing implementation evidence and uncompleted checks remain. No closure is claimed.

**Ready, P1.** All-input 1,148-row outcomes ledger and bounded append-only expansion tooling are landed (`d2a123e`, `91c3e55`). Remaining work is evidence-driven coverage (real groups/busy photos versus decorative frames), permissions and reviewed intake, not rewriting the importer. Reuse the two selected practice designs; private sealed selections remain inaccessible to development. Preserve all failures and budget safeguards.

---

## Earlier scope and evidence

## Evidence and priority
P1 unless marked otherwise. Reviewed at main `4adaba4`.

Selection defaults to30 layouts/10 templates/4 per template with category caps (`scripts/lica-batch.ts:47-48,64-95`); CLI exposes seed/MB only. Unsupported/unavailable inputs are filtered before manifest and full denominator is console-only. Busy-photo coverage currently counts SVG frames; Krush explicitly disclosed the overcount.

## Scope and dependencies
Finite #7 import-accounting slice. Configurable bounded batches/shards are required, not unlimited downloads or removing memory/input/time safeguards. Keep dataset tooling outside production bundle.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Persist machine-readable disposition for every scanned input: supported/adapted/unsupported/unavailable/not-selected with stable ID and reason; totals reconcile exactly.
- [ ] Expose documented layout/family/per-family budgets or sharding so accumulated evaluation can exceed pilot defaults without source edits; preserve deterministic positive controls.
- [ ] Classify real grouped content and busy-photo text separately from SVG frames/decorations; publish explicit uncovered categories rather than inflating counts.
- [ ] Test skipped fonts, invalid source, unsupported transform, exhausted byte budget and multi-batch continuation; retain failures and provenance without downloading unapproved assets.

## Delivery and closure
Read the [dated roadmap/adversarial review](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/roadmap-2026-09-22.md) and repository instructions. Plan under docs/plans, demonstrate meaningful failing behavior before production changes, preserve valid positive controls, run npm test/build and required native/browser checks. Link commit, plan, red/green and final evidence before closing this issue. Direct validated main commits; optional jo/ branches; no required PR/reviewer. Coordinate shared files. This is planned backlog work, not an instruction to start another In Progress task.

<!-- october-13-priority -->
## October 13 pickup order

Backlog during the current bounded run. First finish independent typography evidence #95, source fidelity #102 and development accounting #98; release coordination #101 selects a justified follow-up only after that evidence. This preserves the existing acceptance scope; no worker is assigned implicitly.
